title: Somich & Associates CPAs Open House
summary: Somich & Associates CPAs opened the doors to its new Willoughby office with an afternoon-into-evening celebration for clients, friends and the local business community.
recap: On Thursday, November 12, Somich & Associates CPAs welcomed clients, colleagues and neighbors to its Client & Community Appreciation Open House, marking the move into the firm's new office on Mentor Avenue in Willoughby, Ohio.

From 2 to 7 p.m., guests toured the new space, caught up over appetizers and drinks, and met the team behind the firm. The open house was a thank-you to the clients and relationships that have helped Somich & Associates grow, and the start of a new chapter for the firm in Lake County.
Andrew Stankus Agency covered the full five hours: arrivals and introductions, the firm's partners and staff with their guests, and the details of the new office.
